subject: bombardier beetle
title: A Toad Swallows This Beetle Whole. Then the Toad Throws Up

scenes.text: A toad swallows this beetle whole. The beetle wins.
Scientists in Japan fed bombardier beetles to toads. About four in ten came back up, alive.
Some sat in a toad's stomach for nearly two hours, then walked away.
The trick is inside the beetle. It mixes chemicals into a near-boiling spray and fires it inside the toad.
Beetles that had already used up their spray were all digested.
So the toad didn't lose its lunch by accident. The beetle made it.

description:
Japanese toads that swallow Asian bombardier beetles vomit them back up about 43% of the time, between 12 and 107 minutes after eating them, and every vomited beetle was alive.
The beetles fire a hot chemical spray inside the toad's stomach. Beetles whose spray had been used up beforehand were all digested.
Would you bet on the toad or the beetle?
first_comment: One beetle spent 107 minutes inside a toad before it came back up. Which animal has the best escape from inside a predator?
